summary: Operator site and Firefly read: $40 daily + tax (weekly $225, monthly $690, seasonal $2,600), 49 60x100-ft sites with septic, water and up to 50-amp metered electric, Firefly booking, a 65+/veteran rate qualifier. Price passes, Google 5.0 (36). But the operator markets it as an ATV/OHV base with ATVs driven from sites to the trailheads, and as a base for workers: drop candidate under the ATV/OHV rule.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (ATV/OHV rule), the operator's own wording on bergamo-camp.com: 'the perfect home base for campers, workers and ATV/OHV enthusiasts'; 'easy access to Minnesota's best ATV trails, OHV trails'; 'Just 1.5 miles from top-rated ATV and horseback riding trails'; 'Our pet-friendly and ATV-friendly campground'; 'Reserve your seasonal RV campsite today and make the most of Minnesota's premier ATV and OHV trails all season long!'; rules: 'ATVs of any kind may only be driven by licensed and insured drivers from their site directly to Tom Jefferson Dr to access trailheads'. The stored note also said 'ATV/golf-cart friendly with on-site trails'. Reviewer to decide.

Long-stay five tests: the operator posts and sells a nightly rate ($40 + tax) and Firefly books single nights, with 10+ of its one site type showing available every night of November-early December 2026. Weekly, monthly and seasonal rates are also posted, seasonal campers get first pick of sites, and 'workers' are named as a market. Test 4 passes on the posted nightly sale; it is not a residential park on the evidence read, but it leans seasonal/workforce. Google 5.0 is well above 4 stars, so the automatic-drop combination does not apply.
Event venue: the site also markets the grounds as an event venue with an 'operating capacity of up to 10,000 people' (festivals). Not itself a criterion; noted for the reviewer.
Price gate: $40 + tax (base, plus Minnesota tax not stated) is under US$50; passes without a gateway exception. RV Life 5 stars, $$.

Google Maps: 'Bergamo Campground', 5.0 from 36 reviews, 15661 Tom Jefferson Dr NW, Solway, +1 218-467-3529, pin 47.52697,-95.10722 (matches the stored pin). Presence: own website with posted rates + Firefly booking = both price and presence.
Phone: stored 218-467-3529 matches the site ('218-GO RELAX') and Google. Website https://www.bergamo-camp.com/ answers 200 and is this campground.

Season left unset: the only dated season is the seasonal-rate term (May 1 - Sept. 30); Firefly shows sites available through early December 2026, so the park may sell nights outside that window. No open/close dates are posted.

Pin: the stored pin 47.52722,-95.10719 sits on the open field west of the camp road; imagery (older) shows a gravel loop with RVs about 230 m north (around 47.5293,-95.1066) and the site's Google link points to 47.5208422,-95.102393, near the highway buildings 0.7 km SE. The site map was not available, so no move is proposed; Google's own pin matches the stored one.
Waterfront: confirmed not waterfront (open field and woods; no water body near).

Note cleaned: dropped the site count, hookups ('water, septic, up to 50-amp metered electric') and 'Both seasonal and short-term/nightly' (fields hold them); dropped 'Newer' and '~7 mi W of Bemidji' (unstated distance) and 'on-site trails' (the site says the trails are 1.5 miles away).
